offers.title: Script: Trend-based Reels & TikToks
offers.description: Researches what is trending right now on TikTok and Instagram Reels for your niche (cited sources), then writes production-ready short-video scripts tied to those trends: 0-3s hook, timestamped beats, on-screen text, voiceover, shot list, sound reference, caption, hashtags, CTA and TikTok vs Reels variants.
offers.deliverable: Trend-linked short-video scripts with hooks, beats, shot lists, captions and platform variants, plus the cited trend analysis
offers.prompt:
[stage:scripts] Write trend-based short-video scripts.
Niche: 
Target audience: 
Platform: TikTok and Instagram Reels
Number of scripts: 3
Target length: 20-35 seconds
Tone:

offers.title: Trends: What's Hot on TikTok & Reels
offers.description: A swarm of parallel research agents checks TikTok Creative Center, Instagram creator sources, marketing press, search-interest signals and your niche, then ranks the hottest short-form video trends with links and stated figures only. No account access needed.
offers.deliverable: Ranked trend table with evidence links, evidence log, how-to-use notes per top trend, method and limits
offers.prompt:
[stage:trends] Find what is hot right now in short-form video.
Niche: 
Region: Global
Time window: last 7 days
Platforms: TikTok and Instagram Reels

offers.title: Onboarding: Build Your Virtual Avatar
offers.description: Builds a virtual avatar of you, the real creator, from your interests, values, story, expertise and moat, so your audience feels it is personal and authentic rather than a generic bot. Includes voice, visual identity, positioning, AI-disclosure guardrails, first video ideas and a reusable Avatar JSON for later Create and Script tasks.
offers.deliverable: Avatar profile, voice and speaking style, visual identity with reference prompt, moat and positioning, authenticity guardrails, content pillars with 5 video ideas, reusable Avatar JSON
offers.prompt:
[stage:onboarding] Build my virtual avatar.
